max_risk.description: Highest risk tier to allow from now on. Ignored if it is higher than the current ceiling. READ is the most restrictive.

devices.description: Restrict to these device keys (intersected with any current restriction).

deny_devices.description: Device keys to forbid outright (added to any existing denials).

deny_tools.description: Tool-name globs to forbid (added to any existing denials).

expires_in_minutes.description: Expire the scope after this many minutes (max 7 days).

label.description: A note recorded with the scope, shown in denials.
